title: Tech Note: Tricks and Tips for Using the Form Wizard - Part 2

historical_commentary.text: This is Part 2 of a two-part guide to using 4D V6's new Form Wizard, a form design tool introduced with V6; Part 1 covered group boxes, active object styles, and button text, while Part 2 focuses on controlling alpha field width in output forms. The Form Wizard itself, as a V6-era tool, has been superseded by many later 4D form design improvements, though controlling field widths on output forms remains a generally relevant form-design concern.
related_updates: The V6-era Form Wizard has been superseded by newer 4D form design tools and capabilities introduced in subsequent versions
Modern 4D form design offers more direct and flexible control over object sizing/width than the V6 Form Wizard's template-driven approach described here
